description: Tell the TrueInterview MCP maintainers that one of its tools failed, returned something wrong, was missing or was confusing. Call it only when a TrueInterview tool itself got in the way (an unavailable error that persists, an answer that contradicts itself), at most once per task; a not_found, invalid_request or rate_limited answer is the tool working. It goes to the maintainers, not to the user's account, and stores nothing: leave out the user's personal details.

description.description: The calls you made, with their arguments and what came back, and what went wrong.

impact.description: blocked: you could not finish; worked_around: you finished another way; friction: it was harder than it should be.

kind.description: broken: a tool failed or answered wrongly; missing: no tool could do it; confusing: a tool or its description was unclear; idea: a suggestion.

task.description: What the user asked you to do, in a short phrase.

tool_name.description: The TrueInterview tool it is about, if one.

name: report_mcp_issue
title: Report a TrueInterview MCP problem
